codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Follow the current in-game redemption instructions or an official Aniimo notice. Enter the code exactly as published and check the mailbox or notice for reward conditions.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: A code may expire or have region, platform, or account restrictions. Check the original official notice; we do not assume a fixed expiry schedule.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: No fixed release schedule has been verified. Check official Aniimo announcements; this site lists a code only after its source and status can be checked.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Some codes have expiry dates or eligibility conditions. Use the official announcement for the specific code rather than assuming all codes follow the same rule.
